nodes.text: UK Health Security Agency published HMPV virus test positive rates and the pattern very clearly shows in Jan every year there is a mild increase in positive rates around 4% for past many years. This shows HMPV is not a new virus and this is been tracked for many years now in UK. https://t.co/kPgqf1OHSH
